Video.summary: An old man (Joel McCrea) recalls his days as a young man (Jody McCrea) fighting Indians in the Old West.
Video.title: Cry Blood, Apache

Video.summary: A New York police officer, shot and wounded by a gangster, travels to Cheyenne, Wyo., to recuperate at his family's ranch, and is surprised to find a bootlegger from New York running a speakeasy there.
Video.title: Broadway to Cheyenne

Video.summary: President Grant helps a cavalry major (Dale Robertson) condemned for helping Dakota Chief Sitting Bull (J. Carrol Naish).
Video.title: Sitting Bull

Video.summary: After the Civil War, cavalryman Capt. Hunt tries to strike peace with Acoma, a Native American chief. However, Judge Wilcox and others provoke Acoma, arresting him and shooting his men, prompting revenge from the chief.
Video.title: New Mexico

Video.summary: A federal investigator (Tim McCoy) poses as an outlaw to catch a gang of counterfeiters which has kidnapped a government engraver.
Video.title: Phantom Ranger

Video.summary: Three U.S. Marshals (Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, Raymond Hatton) work undercover to foil a gang of racketeers.
Video.title: Down Texas Way

Video.summary: Agent Saunders (John Wayne) becomes partners with Fay (Cecelia Parker) to help her fight off a gang run by a local land grabber.
Video.title: Riders of Destiny

Video.summary: Jeb Stuart and George Custer get stationed at Fort Leavenworth in Kansas and work together to stop abolitionist John Brown.
Video.title: Santa Fe Trail

Video.summary: U.S. marshals (Johnny Mack Brown, Raymond Hatton) catch rustlers swapping cattle for Mexican jewels.
Video.title: Raiders of the Border

Video.summary: Stranded settlers (Chill Wills, Lance Fuller, Cathy Downs) enter hostile territory with a wagonload of rifles.
Video.title: Kentucky Rifle

Video.summary: Billy the Kid (Jack Buetel), Doc Holliday (Walter Huston) and Pat Garrett hang out with a hussy (Jane Russell).
Video.title: The Outlaw

Video.summary: Uncle Joe decides to go into the cologne business.
Video.title: Please Buy My Violets

Video.summary: Betty Jo becomes the first female contestant in the horseshoe tournament.
Video.title: The Ringer

Video.summary: The agents go to Wisconsin to investigate an Indian agent's claim.
Video.title: Chippewa Indians

Video.summary: Pat and Stoney hunt a legendary golden wolf that roams the Colorado foothills.
Video.title: The Golden Wolf

Video.summary: Kate tries to restore the self-confidence of Floyd Smoot after he is jilted by his mail-order sweetheart, by pretending to be in love with him.
Video.title: The Courtship of Floyd Smoot

Video.summary: Curtis breaks the throttle of the Cannonball and blocks the way to Kate's jamboree.
Video.title: Is There a Doctor in the Roundhouse?

Video.summary: Pat and Stoney go to California to investigate reports of an anthrax epidemic.
Video.title: Center Fire

Video.summary: While in Wyoming to oversee a land deal, Pat and Stoney take care of a pair of twins.
Video.title: Secret Mission

Video.summary: Mr. Kenyon and his children come across a cache of gunpowder in an abandoned cabin.
Video.title: Border Raiders

Video.summary: A young man is accused of murder; he makes a run for it.
Video.title: Desperate Journey

Video.summary: Judge Roy Bean endeavors to exact justice in the small town of Langtry in the Old West. In this episode, the Judge and Jeff take on the richest man in the valley over water rights.
Video.title: The Cross-Draw Kid

Video.summary: Jeff Taggert's brother is accused of robbing the Del Rio bank; while investigating the case, Jeff becomes implicated in the hold-up.
Video.title: The Defense Rests

Video.summary: The judge learns of a scheme to smuggle guns and ammo to the Indians and finds a way to break it up.
Video.title: Citizen Romeo

Video.summary: Sharon Bender's father is killed when her intentions to marry Adam over his objections are known.
Video.title: The Elopers

Video.summary: Sheriff Blade arrives from Comstock to arrest rancher Del Randall on what appears to the Judge to be trumped-up charges; Bean and Taggart put Del in jail for safety while they investigate.
Video.title: Deliver the Body

Video.summary: Doc resorts to extreme measures to fund his free public clinic.
Video.title: Checkmate
